  note = {\textbf{Revised on 2026-10-20}: adds the gate's SC-04 waiver; since 2026-10-13 (EDN-82) the ratio of \texttt{lgbm-\allowbreak{}basic} is 1.02, not 1.21.},

  decision = {\texttt{lgbm-\allowbreak{}basic} is the candidate the model card and the report put forward, although \texttt{lgbm-\allowbreak{}extended} has the lower pooled MdAPE.
\texttt{lgbm-\allowbreak{}extended} fails SC-06.
SC-04 is missed by every variant on cars over 20 years and is recorded as missed: the threshold stays, the scope gets no age bound, and the segment stays in the breakdown.
The promotion gate waives it through \texttt{params.\allowbreak{}yaml}, citing this entry; \texttt{metrics.\allowbreak{}json} still reports it.},
  rationale = {\emph{Alternatives considered:}
\begin{itemize}[leftmargin=*, topsep=2pt]
\item \texttt{lgbm-\allowbreak{}extended} as the candidate, with SC-06 as a known limitation: overrides the criterion the first time it fires.
\item Routing complete and partial requests to different models: two models and a routing rule.
\item An upper age bound in the scope, or a higher SC-04 threshold: the criterion would pass by removing the rows it fails on.
\item Keeping the gate closed until a variant meets SC-04: no model could be promoted.
\end{itemize}
\par
\emph{Why:} On a request with only the fields FR-01 requires, the MdAPE of \texttt{lgbm-\allowbreak{}extended} rises to 1.65 times its full-input value and that of \texttt{lgbm-\allowbreak{}basic} to 1.02 times; the bound is 1.5.
On that request the ranking reverses.
The extended features worsen the over-20 segment, so they do not fix SC-04.
Without the waiver this accepted miss would block every promotion; every other criterion still gates.},

  response = {Accepted},
  assessment = {Two AI sessions measured SC-06 independently and agreed; one saw that the all-masked scenario is a request with only the required fields.
A failure it had predicted did not reproduce, and it reported that.
AI recommended this option; on 2026-10-20 it laid out the gate options and recommended the waiver, and Lukas decided.},
